description: Build a complete beginner-friendly Business Central FiBu book from practical evidence, Playwright traces, screenshots, clickguides and learning notes.

finalEnvironmentPolicy.rule: Every relevant process must be reproduced in the future German target instance before final German book claims or final screenshots are accepted.

statusTerms.labor-draft: Labor-based draft content or clickguide, useful but not fully proven.
statusTerms.labor-proven: Practically proven in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO, not German final.
statusTerms.labor-blocked: Labor evidence shows a blocker or unresolved cause.
statusTerms.labor-sufficient-for-book-draft: Good enough for a clearly marked labor/preproduction book section.
statusTerms.needs-german-final-rebuild: Must be rebuilt and re-screenshotted in the future German target instance.
statusTerms.german-final-candidate: Prepared for German final reproduction, pending target evidence.
statusTerms.german-final-proof: Proven in the German target instance with final evidence.

loopPrevention.rule: A review case must end in a classification or a next bounded execute/probe/bookdraft action.

bcSpecialistMode.rule: Every run must advance evidence, bookdraft/clickguide, Playwright capability, controlled process trace or BC coverage/atlas truth.
